assertions.name: shift_neutron_h3_finite
assertions.source: canonical Markov trace via NF basis

description: Symbolic-q NF reduction of per-nucleon braids β_p, β_n in H_3(q) = 6-dimensional Hecke algebra of B_3.  Decomposes each nucleon into the 6 fundamental knot operators (NF basis: γ, σ₀, σ₁, L₊, L₋, e⁻) with categorical coefficients c_b(q) ∈ Habiro ring.  Computes shift_NF(β_p), shift_NF(β_n) from the trace decomposition tr_M = Σ c_b · TR_M_SYM[b].  These are the H_3-context shifts; the embedded H_(3A)-context shifts (18 for p, 21 for n) require Littlewood-Richardson branching analysis.
caveats: Predictions may differ from the standalone-empirical shifts (20 for proton, 16 for neutron) due to (a) different trace conventions (this script uses canonical Markov via TR_M_SYM, while the standalone witness uses Schur-Weyl-weighted trace) and (b) the embedded-vs-standalone H-context shift difference.  The empirical n-context shifts (18 for proton, 21 for neutron) in the atomic-braid embedding require Littlewood-Richardson branching analysis (see Sub-lemma 2.1 in docs/audits/2026-05-04-sub-lemma-2-1-categorical-proof.md).
